            if ch == ')':
                inside_parentheses = False
            current_length = 0
        elif not reading_word and not (ch == '_' or ch == '(' or ch == ')'):
            reading_word = True
            current_length += 1
            if index == length - 1 and current_length > max_length:
                max_length = current_length
        elif reading_word:
            current_length += 1
        elif ch == '(':
            inside_parentheses = True
        elif ch == ')':
            inside_parentheses = False

    print(f"{max_length} {total_words}")

if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
